summary: The recorded monster turn stops in JS planning because AD_SLOW reaches the unported mhitm_ad_slow() branch in js/uhitm.js:mhitm_adtyping(). In C, distfleeck runs before mattacku/hitmu in that turn; the helper then prints hitmsg, while HFast=false prevents slowing or its rn2(4) draw. The comparator’s first missing draw is distfleeck’s rn2(5), a reporting symptom of JS preflight refusing the whole turn, not a chronologically later event. Port the whole uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_slow() function and wire its existing AD_SLOW dispatch.

source.branch: mhitm_adtyping() dispatches AD_SLOW. mhitm_ad_slow() first checks magic negation, then returns if defended(AD_SLOW); it otherwise branches for hero attacker, hero defender, or monster-versus-monster. In the reproduced monster-versus-hero branch, magr is not gy.youmonst and mdef is gy.youmonst: hitmsg runs even when negated, while HFast=false short-circuits before rn2(4) and u_slow_down().
callers: uhitm.c:damageum() -> mhitm_adtyping() AD_SLOW arm (hero attacks monster)
mhitu.c:hitmu() -> mhitm_adtyping() AD_SLOW arm (monster attacks hero; reproduced path)
mhitm.c:mdamagem() -> mhitm_adtyping() AD_SLOW arm (monster attacks monster)
dependencies: mhitm_mgc_atk_negated() is evaluated before defended() and supplies the effect gate.
defended() gates the complete effect after the negation check.
Hero-attacker and monster-versus-monster branches use mon_adjust_speed(); the monster-versus-monster branch also clears STRAT_WAITFORU.
The hero-defender branch uses hitmsg(), then HFast, rn2(4), and u_slow_down() in that order.
Visible speed-change messages use Monnam(), pline()/pline_mon(), canseemon(), and gv.vis/canspotmon().

evidence: Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/uhitm.c:3652-3687 defines the entire mhitm_ad_slow() unit: it evaluates mhitm_mgc_atk_negated() before defended(); for a hero defender it always calls hitmsg() after the defense check, then calls u_slow_down() only when !negated && HFast && !rn2(4). Port this whole source function, preserving the three attacker/defender branches and call/RNG order.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/uhitm.c:4782-4832 dispatches AD_SLOW directly to mhitm_ad_slow(). Its production entry callers are damageum() at uhitm.c:4854, hitmu() at mhitu.c:1191, and mdamagem() at mhitm.c:1059; keep all three routes wired through the existing dispatcher.

At the frozen recording zero-based step 33, a Skeleton reaches AT_TUCH/AD_SLOW against a normal Wizard (HFast=false); C records the hit/touch message and completes the boundary. js/uhitm.js:4977 instead calls unported("mhitm_ad_slow"), causing JS preflight to refuse the planned turn. Capsule C62 reports the comparator’s first missing C draw as rn2(5) in distfleeck(monmove.c:538), one-based step 34. That is a first-mismatch reporting symptom, not a later C event: distfleeck occurs before mattacku/hitmu in the C turn, while the JS refusal prevents the entire turn boundary.

Capsule 2 links the exact frozen recording challenges/cases/v19/skeleton-slows-wizard-c62-pager-corrected.session.json (SHA-256 426552d7bb89c9114812d650e0a6ed22452771762ff98976fe6379df6c3a537a) and C62 accepted-main per-case receipt/stdout with verified hashes a290965d8cc615081185dbbdea7a5d360244521da14e35f64b1361217b85c8ec and 1cb9d87a0e82122f05f87cf8c0ab6ab1a2f0edbb8e82c36d167bc94e590b54df. Their causal diagnosis is uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping(AD_SLOW) -> mhitm_ad_slow hero-defender branch; HFast=false proves branch reach but no speed mutation.
